headerDisplay: Create a developer token in the Flipped portal under **APIs and MCPs → Tokens**. Choose scope **Read** and the longest expiry (365 days). Run this plugin as a child bridge.

token.title: Developer token
token.description: Starts with fdk_. A read token is enough.

accountNumber.title: Account number
accountNumber.description: Needed only when your login has more than one account. The log lists the account numbers to choose from.

nmi.title: NMI
nmi.description: Needed only when the account has more than one meter. The log lists the NMIs to choose from. Set it before you build automations: adding, changing or removing it later removes every Flipped Energy accessory and creates new ones, and Apple Home deletes the automations that used the old ones.

priceHighThresholdCentsPerKwh.title: Wholesale Price High threshold (c/kWh, wholesale, excluding GST)
priceHighThresholdCentsPerKwh.description: Leave empty to use the market's own Elevated / Spike level.

priceLowThresholdCentsPerKwh.title: Wholesale Price Low threshold (c/kWh, wholesale, excluding GST)
priceLowThresholdCentsPerKwh.description: May be negative. Leave empty to use Unusually low or negative.

availabilitySensors.title: Rates Unavailable and Wholesale Price Unavailable sensors

wholesalePriceSensor.title: Wholesale Price as a light sensor (c/kWh shown as lux)

wholesalePriceLevelSensor.title: Wholesale Price Level as an air quality sensor

eveHistory.title: Energy history for the Eve app

matterEnergy.title: Energy as Matter electrical sensors (experimental; needs this platform on a child bridge with Matter enabled)
